scope: Independent alarm occurrences, trusted recovery, scoped operator handling, process evidence and original-object navigation
environment: Isolated loopback-only software Modbus TCP, explicitly named synthetic/non-measured sources. No production equipment or real control. Protocol writes remained zero.

browser_journey.configuration: A_HIGH and B_HIGH definitions were created through the actual alarm-type forms with threshold >40. Underlying isolated A/B groups, read-only channels and points were prepared through public product APIs.
browser_journey.operator_scope: A-only personal operator saw A records; guessed B acknowledgement returned404. Both UI and backend used actual object scope, not an administrator token for operator requests.
browser_journey.acknowledgement: Actual confirmation dialog retained actor, note and time while the source remained45 and the process stayed active. No value, command or automatic-control grant was changed.
browser_journey.rapid_recurrence: Actual TCP source changed45→20→46. Initial journey observed300ms between recovery and new occurrence; final build observed299ms. Old process retained acknowledgement and recovery, new process had a different ID and no actor/note.
browser_journey.unknown_input: Failed A reads preserved the active occurrence and displayed recovery not yet confirmed. No zero value or physical recovery was invented.
browser_journey.navigation_red: A channel alarm previously opened B's latest point history.
browser_journey.navigation_green: Device/channel alarms show explicit scope and relevant point choices. A's scope listed only A's point; selecting it opened A history. Invalid explicit targets never fall back to an unrelated recent point.
browser_journey.query_failure: Injected GET /ems/alarms503 removed current cards and counts, closed a pending acknowledgement dialog and displayed unavailable with retry; no system-normal claim.
browser_journey.permission_revocation: With an actual account downgrade and a delayed older alarm response, the old UI kept its acknowledgement dialog despite displaying Viewer. After the fix, policy identity invalidated the query immediately; the delayed response did not reopen the dialog or restore acknowledgement buttons.
browser_journey.history_withdrawal: Deleting a selected isolated point while another remained previously left its legend and line visible. After filtering/pruning selection against current scope, a fresh withdrawal removed the selected point, legend and polylines.
browser_journey.final_console: No console errors; no failed requests in the final recent network buffer. Earlier invalid fixture setup, deliberately injected failures and permission denials were expected test cases.

rulings.decision: Use the approved host plan and a small ignored execution record instead of another planning document
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Future execution must consult the local ticket, committed tests and this evidence

rulings.decision: Stable condition keys for producers, unique occurrence IDs for handling; no fallback alias
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Old callers must adopt returned IDs rather than target whichever process is current

rulings.decision: Lifecycle events cannot be suppressed by flood protection
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Frequent true recoveries create more real records; notifications may be controlled separately

rulings.decision: Keep one App-owned query hook and update the existing source-location check accordingly
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Additional consumers must not mount independent alarm pollers

rulings.decision: Treat unavailable input as unknown, not normal; configuration retirement is administrative
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Operators may need explicit verification rather than seeing a convenient recovered state

rulings.decision: Serialize accepted-observation delivery and pause threshold evaluation through supported configuration mutations
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Configuration changes can temporarily mark related evaluation unknown until refresh; callbacks must remain bounded

rulings.decision: Latch known evidence-write loss as unavailable/unconfirmed rather than silently return zero or success
rulings.cost_if_wrong: Storage maintenance is required; lost evidence is not reconstructed and full crash/disk recovery is outside this ticket

limits: Single Go service, no new notification channels or alarm management center
Only isolated read-only software sources in acceptance
No production devices, hardware writes, HA or old ziot changes
No claim that acknowledgement repairs physical faults or grants automatic control
No automatic tasks06/07, push, PR or GitHub issue publication
